content.text: 按普通流程计划多词实现边界

<proposed_plan>
# Invalid Multiword Implementation Assignment

## Summary
- 结论：sub-agent 不能承接多词实现任务。

## Flow Decision
- `flow_type`: `normal`
- `flow_source`: `user_explicit`
- `lock_status`: `locked`
- 开发基线：`origin/main`

## Goals
- 目标 1: 拦截多词实现任务
  checker 必须拒绝 implement the bug fix、implement the code changes 与 implement this feature。

## Non-goals
- 不开放 sub-agent 的任何实现权限。

## Task Orchestration
- wave: 1
  - sub-agent:bug-fix [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => implement the bug fix (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:code-changes [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => implement the code changes (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:feature [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => implement this feature (skill: $normal-flow)

## Acceptance & Validation
- checker 必须报告 `SUB_AGENT_SHARED_WRITE_FORBIDDEN`。

## Assumptions/Defaults
- 用于负例：已确定
</proposed_plan>
